anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
Which behavior should the report view apply when the user switches workspaces?
A) clear all filters - every switch starts the report view from an unfiltered state.
B) preserve all active filters - the current filter set carries across the switch unchanged.
C) restore each workspace's last filters - each workspace reopens with the filters it had when last viewed.
Recommendation: B - it matches what the workspace-change handler in `ui/report-view.ts:30` already does, so existing users see no change and no per-workspace filter state is added beside the resolver.
